c-member-connect-app.3.evidence: Guest GET /jetonomy/v1/app/config -> 200 with app_name, labels, accent_color, logo/login_bg urls, terms/privacy/support urls, pro_active, app_enabled, features, attachments, auth; no member data.

c-member-connect-app.4.evidence: bob GET /app/config -> 200 with the same keys (cookie auth, not an app credential); pro_active false on this Free stack.

c-member-connect-app.5.evidence: No app credential was minted, so revoke/401 not run.

c-member-connect-app.6.evidence: Guest on /community/connect-app/?scheme=jetonomy is redirected to wp-login.php?redirect_to=...; return after login not followed.

c-member-connect-app.7.evidence: bob with scheme=evilscheme and with no scheme: 'This connection link is not valid - The link that opened this page did not come from an app this site recognises.' with a 'Back to the community' link; nothing minted.

c-member-connect-app.9.evidence: Needs a valid bridge to reach the rate limiter.

c-member-connect-app.13.evidence: The valid connect card never rendered; the invalid-link page has a single 'Back to the community' link.

c-member-connect-app.16.evidence: BuddyNext is not active on the Free stack.
